objective: Create Product Hunt launch assets for 'Niki for Code': positioning copy (tagline/description/launch-tags/shoutouts/first-comment/FAQ), a full narrative demo GIF via the existing Pillow renderer, a 240x240 thumbnail, and 5-8 gallery PNG frames at 1270x760.

criteria.label: Thumbnail 240x240 PNG exists
criteria.check: test -f public/agent-demos/thumbnail.png && ffprobe -v error -select_streams v:0 -show_entries stream=width,height -of csv=p=0 public/agent-demos/thumbnail.png

criteria.label: At least 5 gallery PNG frames at 1270x760 exist

tasks.desc: Author launch copy reference doc (plans/product-hunt-launch-copy.md): tagline <=60, description <=500, 3 launch tags, 3 shoutouts, pre-written first comment, FAQ templates. Verify char counts.

Extend tools/render_agent_demo.py: add a 'full' narrative CLIP sequencing the whole pipeline (prompt -> planner -> coder -> tester -> red -> reviewer -> diff/branch -> report), refactor draw to accept W/H so the narrative + gallery render at 1270x760.

Run renderer: produce full.gif (narrative), thumbnail.png, gallery-*.png; verify file sizes and dimensions.
Wire assets into the site (copied full.gif -> public/demo.gif, in scope) and verify `npm run build` passes.
Run all criteria; if pass, mark goal complete and commit.
